title: HPV associated oropharyngeal tumor incidence.
summary:
Head and neck tumors are due to risk factors such as alcohol and smoking, as well as infections with human papillomavirus (HPV). This virus plays an important role in the emergence of oropharyngeal carcinoma.

There are no reliable data on the frequency of HPV-related oropharyngeal tumors in Germany. In order to close this data gap and thus also to evaluate the efficacy of vaccination in the future, anonymous data collection is planned.

interventions.name: Patients with initial diagnosis of oropharyngeal tumors.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with newly diagnosed oropharyngeal tumors are included. The collection and analysis of the data is done according to DSGVO. Both HPV-positive oropharyngeal tumors as well as HPV-negative oropharyngeal tumors are included.
Exclusion criteria:
None
